note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): Bank Muscat, National Bank of Oman and Bank Dhofar. Bank Muscat's card page answered behind a captcha check and Bank Dhofar's behind Cloudflare on 2026-10-30, and neither was read (an earlier reading of Bank Muscat's tariff found its cards' fees but not their interest). National Bank of Oman's key facts statements for its credit cards, read in full: the Gold (read 2026-10-29 and again 2026-10-30), the Signature and the Infinite, the three the bank publishes at its key-facts address (the Platinum's didn't answer). Each is written with its annual fee, VAT included (21, 47.25 and 94.5 rials), waived in full when the year's spending is more than 1,500, 2,500 or 3,600 rials (written as a waiver on that spending); interest of 1.5% a month on a card held against salary (the 1.66% on a card against a pledged deposit isn't written, the game holding no pledged deposit); a cash advance fee of 3.15% or 3.675 rials, whichever is higher; a foreign transaction fee of 2.75% (2.5% for Sadara Priority and Private Banking, not modelled); a late payment fee of 5.250 rials a month where nothing is paid (the same fee on a partial payment, written once); an over-limit fee of 5.250 each time; and a minimum of 5% of the amount due, which the statements give as the least a holder can pay each month. They state no grace period.
